ruling: USB is for flashing firmware and bench testing only. It is not a product transport and never will be.
consequences: A USB-tethered local voice path has no shipping form. Do not propose it, and do not propose anything else premised on the pendant being cabled to a Mac in normal use — several existing proposals are. The shipping path is pendant -> LTE-M -> relay.
what_to_propose_instead: Making that path degrade well when LTE is absent is the real version of the problem, and is worth proposing.
